title: Portrait of Smooth (Who Doesn't Hold Still)
content: Dogs don't pose for their portraits, and Smooth is no exception, as I demonstrate in this new video (Link to video onYouTube).I start wild and loose, skipping a preliminary drawing and painting the main lines with a brush. There's a big change halfway through, as I decide to put him in a standing pose instead of a sitting pose.The painting remains for a while in a chaotic, fluid state until, little by little, it starts to look more like the model.
